data.name: GetById
data.value: SELECT id, name, inn, creator_id, parent_company_id, region, revenue, count_of_employees, bank_profile_id, created_at FROM companies WHERE id = @id

data.name: GetByUser
data.value: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.inn, c.creator_id, c.parent_company_id, c.region, c.revenue, c.count_of_employees, c.bank_profile_id, c.created_at FROM companies c JOIN company_members m ON m.company_id = c.id WHERE m.user_id = @userId

data.name: Create
data.value: INSERT INTO companies (id, name, inn, creator_id, parent_company_id, region, revenue, count_of_employees, bank_profile_id, created_at) VALUES (@id, @name, @inn, @creator_id, @parent_company_id, @region, @revenue, @count_of_employees, @bank_profile_id, @created_at) RETURNING id, name, inn, creator_id, parent_company_id, region, revenue, count_of_employees, bank_profile_id, created_at

data.name: Update
data.value: UPDATE companies SET name = COALESCE(@name, name), inn = COALESCE(@inn, inn), region = COALESCE(@region, region), revenue = COALESCE(@revenue, revenue), count_of_employees = COALESCE(@count_of_employees, count_of_employees), bank_profile_id = COALESCE(@bank_profile_id, bank_profile_id) WHERE id = @id

data.name: SetIndustriesInsert
data.value: INSERT INTO company_industries (company_id, industry_id) VALUES (@companyId, @industryId) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

data.name: GetIndustries
data.value: SELECT i.id, i.code, i.name FROM industries i JOIN company_industries ci ON ci.industry_id = i.id WHERE ci.company_id = @companyId ORDER BY i.code

data.name: GetMembers
data.value: SELECT company_id, user_id, joined_at FROM company_members WHERE company_id = @companyId ORDER BY joined_at

data.name: GetChildren
data.value: SELECT id, name, inn, creator_id, parent_company_id, region, revenue, count_of_employees, bank_profile_id, created_at FROM companies WHERE parent_company_id = @parentId ORDER BY name

data.name: AddMember
data.value: INSERT INTO company_members (company_id, user_id, joined_at) VALUES (@companyId, @userId, @joinedAt) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
